decisions.reason: The accelerator program is a service far from the firm's core machinery and recycling engineering knowledge, which makes its results hard to interpret, but it builds on the established offer, costs little, and is visible on the home page, so it is kept for now despite elevated risk.

A bio-based bitumen binder is a materials and chemistry product remote from the firm's modular recycling machinery expertise, so its absorptive capacity to learn from and improve it is weak, and resources are better redirected to the core WASTX lines.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's waste-treatment machinery knowledge and is backed by a cooperation partner (ERMAFA) and in-house R&D, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and refine it.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely within the firm's core decentralized recycling technology and in-house R&D, giving it high absorptive capacity to iterate on early results.
